description: This Java class 'KvProtoUtil' provides utility methods for converting between internal data representations of key-value entries and their protocol buffer (protobuf) counterparts used in transport. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, and mapping of data types, as well as handling lists of such entries.

classes.name: KvProtoUtil
classes.description: Utility class for converting between internal key-value data representations and protobuf messages used in transport.

methods.name: toAttributeKvList
methods.description: Converts a list of TsKvProto protobuf objects to a list of AttributeKvEntry objects.

methods.name: attrToTsKvProtos
methods.description: Converts a list of AttributeKvEntry objects to a list of TsKvProto protobuf objects.

methods.name: toTsKvProtoList
methods.description: Converts a list of TsKvEntry objects to a list of TsKvProto protobuf objects.

methods.name: fromTsKvProtoList
methods.description: Converts a list of TsKvProto protobuf objects to a list of TsKvEntry objects.

methods.name: toTsKvProto
methods.description: Creates a TsKvProto protobuf message from a timestamp and KvEntry.

methods.name: toTsKvProto
methods.description: Creates a TsKvProto protobuf message from a timestamp, KvEntry, and optional version.

methods.name: fromTsKvProto
methods.description: Converts a TsKvProto protobuf message to a TsKvEntry object.

methods.name: toKeyValueTypeProto
methods.description: Converts a DataType to its corresponding protobuf KeyValueType.

methods.name: fromKeyValueTypeProto
methods.description: Converts a protobuf KeyValueType to its corresponding DataType.

methods.name: toTsKvProtoBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for TsKvProto protobuf message from timestamp and KvEntry.

methods.name: fromTsValueProtoList
methods.description: Converts a list of TsValueProto protobuf objects to a list of TsKvEntry objects.

methods.name: toTsValueProto
methods.description: Creates a TsValueProto protobuf message from a timestamp and KvEntry.

methods.name: fromTsValueProto
methods.description: Converts a TsValueProto protobuf message to a KvEntry object.
